answer: A simultaneous voyage stops bulk fakes: each identity locks a 70-credit basalt bond and awaits the falcon beacon. The falcon beacon issues a fresh challenge; each answers in 60 seconds, key-signed. No operator can answer a thousand challenges, so each fake pays 115: 1,000 fakes pay 115,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented agents carry the owner's key, so a second reply burns both. Honest agents join one voyage, pay 45, and keep their basalt bond.
